review_notes: I read the whole 110-line file. It is one theorem and declares no simp lemmas or attributes. The only simp-interface issue is in `hgapPair`, which unfolds `O3.pairing` by hand with `simp only`. I checked O3/Geometry.lean (which has simp lemmas for neg), O3/Stage9Telescoping.lean, V7/Proofs/ResidualAlgebra.lean, and the other call sites that use the same simp set. I did not run Lean, so I can't say whether the proposed `@[simp]` lemmas would work with each downstream `simp` call. In particular, I didn't check whether they would interact with other simp sets that mention `pairing`. I found no rewrite-direction problems or loops in this file. `lpNorm_neg` is already `@[simp]`, and the file applies it with `exact`, which is fine.

findings.problem: `O3.pairing` is a bare `def`. Its simp lemmas stop at `pairing_neg_left` and `pairing_neg_right`, both `@[simp]`. There is no simp lemma for subtraction in either argument in the module that defines it. The same lemma is also duplicated under other names. `O3.pairing_sub_left` exists but is not `@[simp]` and lives in the late file O3/Stage9Telescoping. `V7.ResidualAlgebra.pairing_sub_left` and `pairing_sub_right` are also not `@[simp]`. As a result, this proof unfolds `pairing` into a raw `Finset` sum and rebuilds the same simp set (`O3.pairing, Pi.sub_apply, mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib`). That exact `simp only [O3.pairing, Pi.sub_apply, mul_sub, ...]` call also appears in OutsideGradient.lean (l.109), Stage3BelowTwo/Geometry.lean (l.310, 313) and Stage2/GuardSoundness.lean (l.80). The normal form at `hfirst` and the goal is therefore a coordinate sum, not `pairing a b - pairing a c`.
findings.proposed_change: In O3/Geometry.lean, next to `pairing_neg_left` and `pairing_neg_right`, add `@[simp] theorem pairing_sub_left (x y z : Point d) : pairing (x - y) z = pairing x z - pairing y z` and the matching `pairing_sub_right`. Remove or alias the duplicates in Stage9Telescoping and ResidualAlgebra. Then replace the hand-unfolding with `simp only [O3.pairing_sub_right, O3.pairing_sub_left] at hfirst ⊢; linarith`, or drop the unfolding step if `hfirst` is already in `pairing` form. The new lemmas leave `pairing` folded, and they cannot loop because each rewrite strictly removes a subtraction from an argument.
findings.benefit: One canonical, discoverable simp interface for `pairing` over subtraction replaces about five hand-written copies of the unfolding simp set. Proofs like this one stay at the `pairing` abstraction level and no longer expose coordinate sums. This also removes the duplicate lemma statements, which are currently spread over three files.

evidence.excerpt:
@[simp] theorem pairing_neg_right {d : ℕ} (x y : Point d) :
    pairing x (-y) = -pairing x y

theorem pairing_sub_left {d : ℕ} (x y z : Vec d) :
    pairing (x - y) z = pairing x z - pairing y z

lemma pairing_sub_right (x y z : Point d) :
    O3.pairing x (y - z) = O3.pairing x y - O3.pairing x z
